protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed independently against the vendor advisory and clone: Repo.archive() forwards caller-controlled kwargs through Git.transform_kwargs, which renders add_file and add_virtual_file as git archive options. --add-file reads an out-of-repository path into the returned archive; the 3.1.56 guard blocks --exec/--output/-o but omits both archive-addition options.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed b67bd4c730273a9b6cce49a8444fb54e654de540 as the smallest public first-write. It replaces prefix-only archive_tar/archive_tar_gz with Repo.archive(..., **kwargs), documents arbitrary git-archive arguments, and passes those kwargs to self.git.archive. Reverse -S history finds this first write before later moves and formatting changes.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed parent 00c5497f190172765cc7a53ff9d8852a26b91676. Its archive methods construct a local options/kwargs dict containing only prefix and expose no caller kwargs, so the vulnerable option-forwarding surface is absent.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed the BIC is a normal single-parent commit, not a merge, revert, move, or squash aggregate. No finer public member exists to decompose; later repo.py package/file moves preserve rather than introduce the forwarding surface.
